text:
gina.docs: Heads-up: we're renaming the `prompt_template` parameter used in generation helpers to `prompt_schema`. This is a semantics-first rename to clarify that the field defines validation and output constraints, not just a free text template.

Why: `prompt_template` got overloaded with a few responsibilities (templating, validation hints, structured-output contracts). `prompt_schema` makes the intent explicit and aligns with our eval tooling.

Rollout plan: docs + examples updated on launch day; SDKs accept both keys for 60 days with a one-line warning; hosted API will accept both during the window and then return 400 for `prompt_template` after cutoff. Dedicated/Private will get a compat patch.

alex.sdk: JS/Python/Rust SDKs will map legacy key -> new key in the client layer and emit DeprecationWarning/console.warn. We'll also add a small code snippet in the migration guide showing how to move common patterns.

mohit.eng: Runtime change: we'll add the deprecated alias in the request parser and log usage metrics so we can contact heavy users. We'll coordinate the hosted flip as a canary roll.

ci-bot: Reminder: docs site rebuild scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC following the API patch deploy. Expect ~5m of docs generation time.

elenam.pe: I'll draft a public changelog entry and a short customer note for AMs to share with accounts that might have templated infra.

support-bot: I'll prepare two canned responses: one for simple rename questions and one for troubleshooting templating mismatches.

Action items quick list:
- [x] Docs examples & migration guide (gina)
- [ ] SDK patches + deprecation warning (alex)
- [ ] Runtime alias + metrics + canary rollout (mohit)
- [ ] Dedicated/Private compatibility patch plan (mohit/ops)
- [ ] Changelog + AM note (elenam)
- [ ] Support canned replies (support-bot)

If you own an unchecked item drop a :thumbsup: and link the PR/issue. Will review in docs sync next Tue. Thanks!
